validation_samples.text: Thank you for a great and honest review of both products. I have them both as I am a super Techie. To be honest I feel the Meta Displays are as you said polished. Rayneo terrible battery life and as you said no voice control at all. I also feel the sound is clearer and more polished on the Meta Glasses. I bought a neck battery to compensate for the poor battery it adds about 2 hours but for 1300 dollars you would think they could have given something to compensate. I wear my Meta Displays all day they last unless I get a crazy bunch of messages. For 799 vs 1299 Meta is the better deal. I would like to add you can control the Rayneo glasses with a Apple smart watch the gestures are similar to the Nero band but not as polished.
